name: mc-testkit-skill
description: Codex workflows for wiring mc-testkit E2E and serve testing into Minecraft Bukkit/Paper/Folia/Spigot plugin projects.

interface.longDescription: Reusable Codex workflows for adding mc-testkit to Bukkit, Paper, Folia, and Spigot plugin projects, including template-source confirmation, DSL wiring (backends/proxies/scenarios/version matrix/Maven-coordinate artifact sources/persistent run dirs), harness and bot setup, serve mode with console commands, lifecycle hooks, task selection, and result-file troubleshooting.
defaultPrompt: Use mc-testkit to add E2E smoke testing to this Paper plugin.
Use mc-testkit to add a cross-server scenario with a mineflayer bot.
Use mc-testkit to debug why this E2E result file failed.
